name: rail-nav
title: Rail Nav
description: A top nav bar that collapses to its mobile menu off its own measured width via ResizeObserver, not a CSS breakpoint: nest it in a sidebar and it still gets it right. A shared sliding pill tracks whichever link is hovered, hovering "Product" or "Solutions" drops a live mega-panel of preview tiles beneath the bar, and a soft glow trails the pointer along the top edge. Switch the frame to "Mobile" to see the same component fall back to a slide-down menu.
